title: Merge 2 specialised systems: q13, q16
summary: Both source patches (q13, q16) were already applied cleanly in the working tree. I made no further edits. The tree builds (BUILD OK). The bench run checks results against the current best before timing, and both templates passed. Timings: q13 went from 735.6 ms to 501.4 ms (-31.8%), q16 from 192.4 ms to 165.2 ms (-14.1%), geomean -23.5%. That was the quick bench run: 2 bindings per template, 4 hot runs each, where differences under about 5% are noise.
notes: There was no conflict and no change interfered with another template. Both templates sped up in the merged build, so nothing was guarded or dropped. I did not compare against the single-template specialised builds, so I can't confirm the merge loses nothing against them.
